purpose: Teach: 被疑/面会/先送り/白紙/水質/非公式/たたき台/商事

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 被疑が及ぶ可能性、内部監査で確認しろ。
lines.en: There's a risk this could extend to us. Have internal audit verify it.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Crisp attack on the opener. No breath wasted. Eyes steady on Kenji, expecting compliance without needing reassurance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察との面会、今週中に。
lines.en: Understood. We'll meet with the police this week.
lines.style: Measured, respectful. Slight nod on the first word. Quiet confidence — he's already thinking through logistics. Calm, efficient delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 発表、先送りせず、迅速に。
lines.en: Don't delay the announcement. Move quickly.
lines.style: Sharp, direct. Weight on 'don't delay.' Composed but leaving no room for negotiation. Brief and final — that's an order.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報、白紙からの再構築です。
lines.en: Understood. PR is starting from scratch and rebuilding.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, showing he's already parsed the work ahead. Steady eye contact. Not defensive — just laying out what needs to happen.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 河川水質、調査、自治体と組め。
lines.en: Water quality in the river — we survey it with the city government.
lines.style: Precise, tactical. Slight pause before 'with the city' — indicating the political weight of that partnership. Still commanding but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 非公式チャネルでも、情報、収集中です。
lines.en: We're gathering information through unofficial channels too.
lines.style: Quiet assurance beneath the words. Not bragging — just reporting capability. Lean slightly forward on 'unofficial' — showing he understands what Hiroshi wants to know.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 対策のたたき台、明日朝、見せろ。
lines.en: Show me the countermeasure draft tomorrow morning.
lines.style: Clean directive. No question mark in the voice. Expects the work done. Professional distance — but the fact he's asking for tomorrow means urgency without drama.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商事会社と歩調を合わせ、進めます。
lines.en: We'll coordinate with the trading company and move forward together.
lines.style: Steady, collaborative tone while still showing deference. Slight emphasis on 'together' — showing unity is part of the strategy, not just compliance. Calm finish.
